summary: New candidate with Normal/Zombie selection, Start New, Load Saved Game and Resume; a six-stage Forest/Snow/Fire campaign across both modes, authoritative zombie encounters and simpler flat-shaded first-person hands. Existing camp activities, purchased audio/effects and the complete The Camels - Jam Session recording are retained.
verification: 506 selected native tests passed. Nine exact-package gates passed, including six peers on one computer, save/reload, group fire, flight and a live two-process Zombie encounter. All 31 gate processes exited naturally; root reviewed 17 packaged images. Real menu navigation verified New Zombie, quit/relaunch, Resume after selecting Normal, separate New Normal and Load original Zombie, retaining saved mode, seed, run and elapsed time. Nine additional menu screenshots and game-created save checksums were reviewed; both menu sessions exited normally. A full authenticated download matched this ZIP's size and SHA-256. Automated and assistant checks do not establish human acceptance or release readiness.
knownLimits: Human listening, gameplay feel and visual acceptance remain unfinished
Separate-PC Internet/Steam invites and voice, physical Steam Deck/controller and hardware performance remain unverified

Campaign transition diagnostics exercise results, scene-reset and persistence boundaries with accelerated combat/cinematic steps; they do not prove six complete human-played stages or combat balance. The manual menu check stayed at camp and verifies saved state and elapsed time, not earned-stage progress.

The finale capture fixture changes scenery without advancing campaign state, so Snow/Fire diagnostic captures can show a Forest completion title; these captures do not verify production completion wording
The finale is rendered in-game; this candidate does not include a new AI-generated ending video
Save schema 19 migrates older readable saves on a successful save; all co-op peers need protocol winter-hunt-party-54 from this build
Other requested content and completion-reward decisions remain separate; this update does not mark every roadmap feature complete
